title: US Healthcare Clinic Contact, Schema & Chain Detector Input

startUrls.title: Clinic Website URLs
startUrls.description: List of US medical, dental, audiology, chiropractic, optometry, or veterinary clinic URLs to enrich and screen for corporate chain/DSO ownership.

followContactPages.title: Crawl Internal /contact, /about & /locations Pages
followContactPages.description: Automatically discover and inspect up to 2 internal Contact, About, or Locations pages per clinic domain to maximize email, phone, and ownership detection accuracy.

excludeChainsFromOutput.title: Filter Out Corporate Chains (Keep Only Independent / Needs Review)
excludeChainsFromOutput.description: When enabled, clinics classified as 'Chain Excluded' are omitted from the output dataset so your CRM only receives independent practices.

customChainKeywords.title: Custom Excluded Corporate / DSO Keywords (Comma-Separated)
customChainKeywords.description: Optional comma-separated brand names or private-equity MSO/DSO groups to flag as 'Chain Excluded' (e.g. 'SmileDirect, RegionaleCare').

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrent Clinic Requests
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel async HTTP clinic requests.
